messages.author: c80c2f1aa568862c
messages.subject: Error: object 'MainMetric' not found
parts:
Hey,

I ran into the following error when I processed a data file with GGIR v1.9.1.
Error in '{.data.frame`(daysummary_tmp, ,MainMetric):
object 'MainMetric' not found

There was a side effect along with this - Summary report PDF file does not open and is just 1 KB in size.

Upon debugging, I found that the device was stationary for more than 16 hours (includedaycrit) so the physical metrics were not calculated within the method g.analyse.R.
I have attached the compressed meta folder to this message.
Is there an argument in the shell script, that I can set, to safely exit out of the GGIR process and maybe not create a summary report in such an instance.
Can anyone help me with this.

Thanks,
Sriram

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Error: object 'MainMetric' not found
parts:
Dear Sriram,

Just looked at your file and the whole week is classified as non-wear time, would you expect so? That's why reports are not generated, there are no results to show.

Best,
Jairo

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Error: object 'MainMetric' not found
parts:
GGIR expects that the first data file in a data set to have at least some days where the accelerometer was worn.
If this is the case and if it is followed by an experiment where the accelerometer was not worn during the entire measurement then the reports should correctly show that the second experiment is not useful.
Vincent
.
